endpoints.description: Updates an existing account. Note that all parameters must be submitted, omitted parameters are treated as empty values. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: categoryId
params.description: The ID of the category. See Account category .

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the account to update.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the account. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: number
params.description: The account number. Must be numeric but can contain a decimal point.

params.name: allocations
params.description: Allocations to cost centers, if this account is either an expense or revenue account. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: share
fields.description: Allocation share. For example, if you have two cost centers, and one has a share of 3, and the other has a share of 1, then the amount is allocated 3:1 (which equals 75% to 25%).

fields.name: toCostCenterId
fields.description: ID of cost center to allocate to. See Cost center .

params.name: attachments
params.description: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: fileId
fields.description: ID of the file to attach. See File .

params.name: currencyId
params.description: The ID of the account's currency. Leave empty to use the default currency. See Currency .

params.name: custom
params.description: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values> . Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: isInactive
params.description: Mark this account as inactive. Inactive accounts are greyed out in the list and are no longer suggested. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: notes
params.description: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: targetMax
params.description: The target maximum balance (aka budget) you hope this account to stay beneath of by the end of the fiscal period. This will then be displayed by the Targets report, comparing your target to the actual balance. Please first switch to the desired fiscal period to set the target for that period, see Switch fiscal period .

params.name: targetMin
params.description: The target minimum balance you hope this account to hit by the end of the fiscal period. This will then be displayed by the Targets report, comparing your target to the actual balance. Please first switch to the desired fiscal period to set the target for that period, see Switch fiscal period .

params.name: taxId
params.description: The ID of the tax code associated with this account. See Tax codes .

endpoints.description: Creates a new currency. The currency code must be unique. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: code
params.description: The 3-characters currency code, like CHF, EUR, etc.

params.name: description
params.description: An optional description of the currency. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: isDefault
params.description: Use the currency as the default / main currency. This can only be set if there are no book entries yet. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: rate
params.description: The exchange rate of this currency into the default currency. If this currency is the default currency, then the rate is 1. For most currencies, CashCtrl automatically retrieves the exchange rate, so this doesn't have to be set and will be ignored. Only set the rate for unsupported currencies. For supported currencies, see Get exchange rate .

endpoints.description: Creates a new custom field for the given type. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: dataType
params.description: The data type of the custom field. Possible values: TEXT, TEXTAREA, CHECKBOX, DATE, COMBOBOX, NUMBER, ACCOUNT, PERSON.

params.name: rowLabel
params.description: Label displayed left of the field. If multiple custom fields have the same rowLabel , they will be displayed on the same row. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: type
params.description: The type of custom field, meaning: which module the custom field belongs to. Possible values: JOURNAL, ACCOUNT, INVENTORY_ARTICLE, INVENTORY_ASSET, ORDER, PERSON, FILE, SALARY_STATEMENT.

params.name: fieldInfo
params.description: An optional description of the custom field (displayed by hovering over an info icon). This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: fieldLabel
params.description: Smaller label displayed above the field. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: fieldTextRight
params.description: Optional text displayed right of the field. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the custom field group. If empty, the custom field is in the default group 'More'. Groups are basically displayed as tabs in the edit dialog, whereas the default tab is 'More'.

params.name: isInactive
params.description: Mark the custom field as inactive. Inactive custom fields are no longer displayed anywhere. However, the data is not removed, as opposed to deleting the custom field. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isMulti
params.description: Is the custom field a multi-field? Multi-fields can have multiple values. The data is then stored as JSON array, like for example ["val1", "val2", "val3"] . Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: The maximum width of the field. By default, the field width is stretched.

params.name: values
params.description: Values the user can choose from, if the data type is COMBOBOX. Ignored otherwise. Use the JSON format like this: ["red","green","blue"] . Note that these values are not enforced, the user can still set arbitrary text as the custom field value.

params.name: variableName
params.description: An optional, more meaningful variable name, instead of the default $customField variable name. Must start with a $ and contain only alphanumeric characters.

params.description: The name of the article. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: attachments
params.description: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: fileId
fields.description: ID of the file to attach. See File .

params.name: binLocation
params.description: The place within the building (e.g. A15, B04, C11, etc.) to locate the article. See locationId . isStockArticle must be true, ignored otherwise.

params.name: categoryId
params.description: The ID of the category. See Article category .

params.name: currencyId
params.description: The ID of the currency. Leave empty to use the default currency. See Currency .

params.name: custom
params.description: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values> . Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: description
params.description: A description of the article. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: isInactive
params.description: Mark the article as inactive. The article will be greyed out. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isPurchasePriceGross
params.description: The purchase price is net (excluding tax) by default. This defines the purchase price as gross (including tax). Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isSalesPriceGross
params.description: The sales price is net (excluding tax) by default. This defines the sales price as gross (including tax). Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isStockArticle
params.description: Whether the article has a stock, i.e. the stock should be tracked and updated via sales and purchase orders. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: lastPurchasePrice
params.description: The last purchase price of the article. Net (excluding tax) by default, see isPurchasePriceGross . This price is automatically updated by purchase orders.

params.name: locationId
params.description: The ID of the location where the article can be found (e.g. a warehouse). See Location . Note that this represents the building whereas the binLocation parameter represents the place within the building. isStockArticle must be true, ignored otherwise.

params.name: maxStock
params.description: The desired maximum stock of the article. isStockArticle must be true, ignored otherwise.

params.name: minStock
params.description: The desired minimum stock of the article. isStockArticle must be true, ignored otherwise.

params.name: notes
params.description: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: nr
params.description: The article number. Leave empty to generate the number with sequenceNumberId .

params.name: salesPrice
params.description: The sales price of the article. Net (excluding tax) by default, see isSalesPriceGross .

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.description: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the article number (see nr ). If this is empty, the sequence number will not update when nr is set. See Sequence number .

params.name: stock
params.description: The current stock of the article. isStockArticle must be true, ignored otherwise.

params.name: unitId
params.description: The ID of the unit (like pcs., meters, liters, etc.). See Units .

params.description: The end date for the recurrence. Orders repeat automatically up until this date, when the recurrence will stop. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: accountId

fields.description: Allocations to cost centers. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: share

endpoints.description: Creates a new category. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: accountId
params.description: The ID of the account, which is typically the debtors account for sales and the creditors account for purchase. See Account .

params.name: namePlural
params.description: The plural name of the category (e.g. 'Invoices'). This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: nameSingular
params.description: The singular name of the category (e.g. 'Invoice'). This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: status
params.description: The status list (like 'Draft', 'Open', 'Paid', etc.) for this order category. At least one status must exist. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: icon
fields.description: The icon/color of the status. Possible values: BLUE, GREEN, RED, YELLOW, ORANGE, BLACK, GRAY, BROWN, VIOLET, PINK.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the status. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

fields.name: actionId
fields.description: An action associated with the status, i.e. what happens after I change the status to this? The action ID looks like this for example: CATEGORY_9. This would mean that another document of the order category with ID 9 will be created after changing to this status (CashCtrl asks the user first). The first part is either CATEGORY or BOOK_TEMPLATE. Then comes an underscore and the actual ID of the category or book template (e.g. BOOK_TEMPLATE_10).

fields.name: isAddStock
fields.description: Whether inventory stock is added with this status. Note that when changing between two statuses that both have isAddStock set, it will only be added once, not twice. No matter how many times you change the status, it's only ever added once. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

fields.name: isBook
fields.description: Whether journal book entries will be created with this status. For example, the invoice status 'Draft' will not create any book entries, but all the other status after that ('Open', 'Paid', etc.) will. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

fields.name: isClosed
fields.description: Whether the status closes / completes the order object. This would be the case, for example, if an invoice has been fully paid. The effect is that the invoice is no longer due, even if past the due date (so no longer marked red). Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

fields.name: isRemoveStock
fields.description: Whether inventory stock is removed with this status. Note that when changing between two statuses that both have isRemoveStock set, it will only be removed once, not twice. No matter how many times you change the status, it's only ever removed once. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: addressType
params.description: Which address of the recipient to use in the order document. Defaults to MAIN. Possible values: MAIN, INVOICE, DELIVERY, SALARY, HISTORICAL, OTHER.

params.name: bookTemplates
params.description: The book (entry) templates defined in this order category. An example of a book template for order categories would be the 'Payment' book template, which already has the appropriate bank account set, so that payments can be added with one click. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: The ID of the account in this book template. This is typically a bank account in case of a payment template, and it's the contra account to the account set on the order (debtors or creditors account). See Account .

fields.name: name
fields.description: A name / description of the book template, which will be used as the description for the actual book entry. Example: 'Payment'. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

fields.name: isAllowTax
fields.description: Whether the actual book entry will allow setting a tax rate. This is to prevent the user from making a mistake (e.g. for payment book entries). Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

fields.name: taxId
fields.description: The ID of the tax code in this book template. This is only used if isAllowTax is true. For a payment book entry template you generally wouldn't allow setting a tax rate. See Tax codes .

params.name: bookType
params.description: Whether the account (see accountId ) is on the debit or credit side in the book entry. Defaults to DEBIT. Possible values: DEBIT, CREDIT.

params.name: currencyId
params.description: The ID of the currency used by default for order objects in this category. Leave empty to use the default currency. See Currency .

params.name: dueDays
params.description: The due days used by default for order objects in this category. The order date + due days equals the due date.

params.name: fileId
params.description: An optional PDF document whose pages are added at the end of the order document. Supported type: PDF. Max. size: 500KB. Use the File API to upload a file and then use the file ID here.

params.name: footerTemplateId
params.description: The ID of the footer text used for order objects in this category.

params.name: hasDueDays
params.description: Whether order objects in this category can have due days. The dueDays parameter is ignored if set to false. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: headerTemplateId
params.description: The ID of the header text used for order objects in this category.

params.name: isDisplayItemGross
params.description: Whether order item totals are displayed as gross (including tax) or net. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isDisplayPrices
params.description: Whether prices and totals are displayed on the document. For example a delivery note might not display prices, but an invoice does. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The ID of the account, which is typically the debtors account for sales and the creditors account for purchase. See Account .

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the category to update.

params.name: namePlural
params.description: The plural name of the category (e.g. 'Invoices'). This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: nameSingular
params.description: The singular name of the category (e.g. 'Invoice'). This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: status
params.description: The status list (like 'Draft', 'Open', 'Paid', etc.) for this order category. At least one status must exist. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: icon
fields.description: The icon/color of the status. Possible values: BLUE, GREEN, RED, YELLOW, ORANGE, BLACK, GRAY, BROWN, VIOLET, PINK.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the status. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

fields.name: actionId
fields.description: An action associated with the status, i.e. what happens after I change the status to this? The action ID looks like this for example: CATEGORY_9. This would mean that another document of the order category with ID 9 will be created after changing to this status (CashCtrl asks the user first). The first part is either CATEGORY or BOOK_TEMPLATE. Then comes an underscore and the actual ID of the category or book template (e.g. BOOK_TEMPLATE_10).

fields.name: isAddStock
fields.description: Whether inventory stock is added with this status. Note that when changing between two statuses that both have isAddStock set, it will only be added once, not twice. No matter how many times you change the status, it's only ever added once. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

fields.name: isBook
fields.description: Whether journal book entries will be created with this status. For example, the invoice status 'Draft' will not create any book entries, but all the other status after that ('Open', 'Paid', etc.) will. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

fields.name: isClosed
fields.description: Whether the status closes / completes the order object. This would be the case, for example, if an invoice has been fully paid. The effect is that the invoice is no longer due, even if past the due date (so no longer marked red). Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

fields.name: isRemoveStock
fields.description: Whether inventory stock is removed with this status. Note that when changing between two statuses that both have isRemoveStock set, it will only be removed once, not twice. No matter how many times you change the status, it's only ever removed once. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: addressType
params.description: Which address of the recipient to use in the order document. Defaults to MAIN. Possible values: MAIN, INVOICE, DELIVERY, SALARY, HISTORICAL, OTHER.

params.name: bookTemplates
params.description: The book (entry) templates defined in this order category. An example of a book template for order categories would be the 'Payment' book template, which already has the appropriate bank account set, so that payments can be added with one click. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: The ID of the account in this book template. This is typically a bank account in case of a payment template, and it's the contra account to the account set on the order (debtors or creditors account). See Account .

fields.name: name
fields.description: A name / description of the book template, which will be used as the description for the actual book entry. Example: 'Payment'. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

fields.name: isAllowTax
fields.description: Whether the actual book entry will allow setting a tax rate. This is to prevent the user from making a mistake (e.g. for payment book entries). Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

fields.name: taxId
fields.description: The ID of the tax code in this book template. This is only used if isAllowTax is true. For a payment book entry template you generally wouldn't allow setting a tax rate. See Tax codes .

params.name: bookType
params.description: Whether the account (see accountId ) is on the debit or credit side in the book entry. Defaults to DEBIT. Possible values: DEBIT, CREDIT.

params.name: currencyId
params.description: The ID of the currency used by default for order objects in this category. Leave empty to use the default currency. See Currency .

params.name: dueDays
params.description: The due days used by default for order objects in this category. The order date + due days equals the due date.

params.name: fileId
params.description: An optional PDF document whose pages are added at the end of the order document. Supported type: PDF. Max. size: 500KB. Use the File API to upload a file and then use the file ID here.

params.name: footerTemplateId
params.description: The ID of the footer text used for order objects in this category.

params.name: hasDueDays
params.description: Whether order objects in this category can have due days. The dueDays parameter is ignored if set to false. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: headerTemplateId
params.description: The ID of the header text used for order objects in this category.

params.name: isDisplayItemGross
params.description: Whether order item totals are displayed as gross (including tax) or net. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isDisplayPrices
params.description: Whether prices and totals are displayed on the document. For example a delivery note might not display prices, but an invoice does. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isSwitchRecipient
params.description: Switch recipient? By default your company is the sender and the client/vendor is the recipient. This flag switches sender and recipient. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: layoutId
params.description: The ID of the layout used for order objects in this category. See Order layout .

params.name: mailSubject
params.description: The mail subject (when sending the document via e-mail). Can contain variables.

params.name: mailTemplateId
params.description: The ID of the mail text used for order objects in this category.

params.description: A message for the payment recipient (included in the pain.001 xml file).

params.name: responsiblePersonId
params.description: The ID of the responsible person (Sachbearbeiter) used for order objects in this category. See Person .

params.name: roundingId
params.description: The ID of the rounding used for order objects in this category. See Rounding .

params.description: The ID of the currency. Leave empty to use the default currency. See Currency .

params.description: The exchange rate from foreign currency to main currency. Only required if the currency is not supported or if you want to use a different rate than suggested.

params.name: custom
params.description: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values> . Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: daysBefore
params.description: The next order will be created X days before the start date. Leave empty or set to 0 to have the next order created on the start date itself. See recurrence parameter.

params.name: description
params.description: A description of the order document.

params.name: discountPercentage
params.description: The discount percentage for the entire order (can be overriden in items).

params.name: dueDays
params.description: The due days. Order date + due days = Due date (the date, when payment is due).

params.name: endDate
params.description: The end date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). Orders repeat automatically up until this date, when the recurrence will stop. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the order group (dossier). Use this to include the order in a dossier with other orders that belong together (e.g. the offer, order confirmation, delivery note and invoice of the same order). This is overridden by previousId (if both are set).

params.name: isDisplayItemGross
params.description: Whether to display item totals as gross (including tax). Defaults to false (net). Possible values: true, false.

params.name: items
params.description: The list of order items. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: The ID of the account (revenue account for sales, expense account for purchase). See Account .

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the item.

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: The price of the item (for one unit).

fields.name: allocations
fields.description: Allocations to cost centers. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: share
fields.description: Allocation share. For example, if you have two cost centers, and one has a share of 3, and the other has a share of 1, then the amount is allocated 3:1 (which equals 75% to 25%).

fields.name: toCostCenterId
fields.description: ID of cost center to allocate to. See Cost center .

fields.name: articleNr
fields.description: The article number.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A description of the item.

fields.name: discountPercentage
fields.description: Discount percentage for the item price.

fields.name: inventoryId
fields.description: The ID of the inventory article. See Inventory .

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: The amount of units of the item. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: taxId
fields.description: The ID of the tax code. See Tax codes .

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of item. Defaults to ARTICLE. Possible values: ARTICLE, TEXT, PAGEBREAK, SUBTOTAL, TITLE, OPTIONTOTAL.

fields.name: unitId
fields.description: The ID of the unit (pcs., hours, etc.). See Units .

params.name: notifyEmail
params.description: The e-mail address to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyPersonId
params.description: The ID of the person to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.description: Whether to send a notification e-mail when orders have been created or not. Leave empty to not send any notification. Possible values: NONE, USER, PERSON, RESPONSIBLE_PERSON, EMAIL.

params.name: notifyUserId
params.description: The ID of the user to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter. Note: User must be in this organization.

params.name: nr
params.description: The order number (e.g. 'IN-2001015' for an invoice). Leave empty to generate the number with sequenceNumberId . This becomes mandatory if a sequence number is set neither here nor in the order category.

params.name: previousId
params.description: The ID of the previous order from which this order is created (Next step / Continue as). The new order will be grouped with the previous order in a dossier. See also groupId . This will override groupId (if both are set).

params.name: recurrence
params.description: The interval of how often the order should be automatically repeated. Leave empty to not repeat the order. See also startDate and endDate . Possible values: MONTHLY, WEEKLY, DAILY, YEARLY, SEMESTRAL, QUARTERLY, BI_MONTHLY, BI_WEEKLY.

params.name: responsiblePersonId
params.description: The ID of the responsible person (Sachbearbeiter). See Person .

params.name: roundingId
params.description: The ID of the rounding to use for the grand total. See Rounding .

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.description: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the order number (see nr ). If empty, the sequence number of the category is used (if set). See Sequence number .

params.name: startDate
params.description: The start date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). This is the date when the order will be repeated next. Should probably be called nextDate instead. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.description: The ID of the status to set. Leave empty to use the first status in the list. See Order category .

endpoints.description: Updates the recurrence of an existing order by order ID. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the order.

params.name: daysBefore
params.description: The next order will be created X days before the start date. Leave empty or set to 0 to have the next order created on the start date itself. See recurrence parameter.

params.name: endDate
params.description: The end date for the recurrence. Orders repeat automatically up until this date, when the recurrence will stop. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.name: notifyEmail
params.description: The e-mail address to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyPersonId
params.description: The ID of the person to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyType
params.description: Whether or not to send a notification e-mail when orders have been created. Leave empty to not send any notification. Possible values: NONE, USER, PERSON, RESPONSIBLE_PERSON, EMAIL.

params.name: notifyUserId
params.description: The ID of the user to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter. Note: User must be in this organization.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: The interval of how often the order should be automatically repeated. Leave empty to not repeat the order (or to remove recurrence). Possible values: MONTHLY, WEEKLY, DAILY, YEARLY, SEMESTRAL, QUARTERLY, BI_MONTHLY, BI_WEEKLY.

params.name: startDate
params.description: The start date for the recurrence. This is the date when the order will be repeated next. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

endpoints.description: Updates an existing order. Note that all parameters must be submitted, omitted parameters are treated as empty values. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: associateId
params.description: The ID of the business partner (customer / vendor). See Person .

params.name: categoryId
params.description: The ID of the category. See Order category .

params.name: date
params.description: The date of the order. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the order to update.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The ID of the account. Leave empty to use the account from the category. See Account .

params.name: attachments
params.description: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: fileId
fields.description: ID of the file to attach. See File .

params.name: currencyId
params.description: The ID of the currency. Leave empty to use the default currency. See Currency .

params.name: currencyRate
params.description: The exchange rate from foreign currency to main currency. Only required if the currency is not supported or if you want to use a different rate than suggested.

params.name: custom
params.description: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values> . Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: daysBefore
params.description: The next order will be created X days before the start date. Leave empty or set to 0 to have the next order created on the start date itself. See recurrence parameter.

params.name: description
params.description: A description of the order document.

params.name: discountPercentage
params.description: The discount percentage for the entire order (can be overriden in items).

params.name: dueDays
params.description: The due days. Order date + due days = Due date (the date, when payment is due).

params.name: endDate
params.description: The end date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). Orders repeat automatically up until this date, when the recurrence will stop. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the order group (dossier). Use this to include the order in a dossier with other orders that belong together (e.g. the offer, order confirmation, delivery note and invoice of the same order). This is overridden by previousId (if both are set).

params.name: isDisplayItemGross
params.description: Whether to display item totals as gross (including tax). Defaults to false (net). Possible values: true, false.

params.name: items
params.description: The list of order items. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: The ID of the account (revenue account for sales, expense account for purchase). See Account .

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the item.

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: The price of the item (for one unit).

fields.name: allocations
fields.description: Allocations to cost centers. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: share
fields.description: Allocation share. For example, if you have two cost centers, and one has a share of 3, and the other has a share of 1, then the amount is allocated 3:1 (which equals 75% to 25%).

fields.name: toCostCenterId
fields.description: ID of cost center to allocate to. See Cost center .

fields.name: articleNr
fields.description: The article number.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A description of the item.

fields.name: discountPercentage
fields.description: Discount percentage for the item price.

fields.name: inventoryId
fields.description: The ID of the inventory article. See Inventory .

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: The amount of units of the item. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: taxId
fields.description: The ID of the tax code. See Tax codes .

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of item. Defaults to ARTICLE. Possible values: ARTICLE, TEXT, PAGEBREAK, SUBTOTAL, TITLE, OPTIONTOTAL.

fields.name: unitId
fields.description: The ID of the unit (pcs., hours, etc.). See Units .

params.name: language
params.description: The language of the document. Possible values: DE, EN, FR, IT.

params.name: notes
params.description: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: notifyEmail
params.description: The e-mail address to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyPersonId
params.description: The ID of the person to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyType
params.description: Whether to send a notification e-mail when orders have been created or not. Leave empty to not send any notification. Possible values: NONE, USER, PERSON, RESPONSIBLE_PERSON, EMAIL.

params.name: notifyUserId
params.description: The ID of the user to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter. Note: User must be in this organization.

params.name: nr
params.description: The order number (e.g. 'IN-2001015' for an invoice). Leave empty to generate the number with sequenceNumberId . This becomes mandatory if a sequence number is set neither here nor in the order category.

params.name: previousId
params.description: The ID of the previous order from which this order is created (Next step / Continue as). The new order will be grouped with the previous order in a dossier. See also groupId . This will override groupId (if both are set).

params.name: recurrence
params.description: The interval of how often the order should be automatically repeated. Leave empty to not repeat the order. See also startDate and endDate . Possible values: MONTHLY, WEEKLY, DAILY, YEARLY, SEMESTRAL, QUARTERLY, BI_MONTHLY, BI_WEEKLY.

params.name: responsiblePersonId
params.description: The ID of the responsible person (Sachbearbeiter). See Person .

params.name: roundingId
params.description: The ID of the rounding to use for the grand total. See Rounding .

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.description: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the order number (see nr ). If empty, the sequence number of the category is used (if set). See Sequence number .

params.name: startDate
params.description: The start date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). This is the date when the order will be repeated next. Should probably be called nextDate instead. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.name: statusId
params.description: The ID of the status to set. Leave empty to use the first status in the list. See Order category .

params.description: The person's first (given) name. Either firstName , lastName or company must be set.

params.name: lastName
params.description: The person's last (family) name. Either firstName , lastName or company must be set.

params.name: addresses
params.description: A list of addresses (street, house number, zip, city, country). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of address. Main address, invoice address, etc. Possible values: MAIN, INVOICE, DELIVERY, SALARY, HISTORICAL, OTHER.

fields.name: address
fields.description: The address (street, house number, additional info). Can contain multiple lines.

fields.name: canton
fields.description: The canton of the address (Switzerland only). Possible values: AG, AI, AR, BE, BL, BS, FR, GE, GL, GR, JU, LU, NE, NW, OW, SG, SH, SO, SZ, TG, TI, UR, VD, VS, ZG, ZH.

fields.name: city
fields.description: The town / city of the address.

fields.name: company
fields.description: Company name of the recipient.

params.description: An alternative name for this person (for organizational chart). This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: attachments
params.description: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: fileId
fields.description: ID of the file to attach. See File .

params.name: bankAccounts
params.description: A list of bank accounts (IBAN, BIC). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: iban
fields.description: The IBAN (International Bank Account Number).

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of bank account, i.e. what is the bank account used for? Possible values: DEFAULT, ORDER, SALARY, HISTORICAL, OTHER.

fields.name: bic
fields.description: The BIC (Business Identifier Code) of your bank.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Some optional notes.

params.description: Unstructured bank information, if IBAN/BIC not available. Otherwise use bankAccounts .

params.name: categoryId
params.description: The ID of the category. See Person category .

params.name: certificateTemplateId
params.description: The ID of the salary certificate template. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: certificateValues
params.description: Values to print directly on the employee's salary certificate. isEmployee must be true, otherwise this is ignored. This overrides any values set on the salary certificate template . This is a map of code -> value, for example: {"F": true, "2.3a": "Bonus"}

params.name: children
params.description: A list of children. isEmployee or isFamily must be set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the child (first and last name).

fields.name: dateBenefitBegin
fields.description: Child benefit start date (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: dateBenefitEnd
fields.description: Child benefit end date (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: dateBirth
fields.description: The child's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: dateInEducation
fields.description: Date since child is in education (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Some optional notes.

params.name: color
params.description: The color to use for this person in the organizational chart. Leave empty for white. Possible values: BLUE, GREEN, RED, YELLOW, ORANGE, BLACK, GRAY, BROWN, VIOLET, PINK.

params.name: contacts
params.description: A list of contact information (e-mail, phone, url, etc.). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: address
fields.description: The actual contact information (e-mail address, phone number, etc.).

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of contact information. Possible values: EMAIL_INVOICE, EMAIL_WORK, EMAIL_PRIVATE, PHONE_RECEPTION, PHONE_WORK, PHONE_PRIVATE, MOBILE_WORK, MOBILE_PRIVATE, FAX, WEBSITE, MESSENGER, OTHER.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Some optional short notes.

params.name: custom
params.description: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values> . Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: dateBirth
params.description: The person's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.name: department
params.description: The department of the person within the company.

params.name: discountPercentage
params.description: Discount percentage for this person, which may be used for orders. This can also be set on the category for all people in that category.

params.name: industry
params.description: The industry of the company or the trade/vocation of the person.

params.name: insuranceContracts
params.description: A list of insurance contracts, if isInsurance is set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: typeId
fields.description: ID of the insurance type (e.g. AHV, BVG, etc.).

fields.name: contractNr
fields.description: Number of the contract with the insurance company.

fields.name: subNr
fields.description: Optional sub-contract number, if sub-contracts exist.

params.name: insuranceMemberNr
params.description: Member number (for insurance). isInsurance must be set.

params.name: insuranceNr
params.description: Insurance number. isInsurance must be set.

params.name: isAutoFillResponsiblePerson
params.description: Whether to autofill the responsible person field in order documents with this person if userId is set. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isCustomer
params.description: Is the person a customer? (role) Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isEmployee
params.description: Is the person an employee? (role) Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isFamily
params.description: Is the person a family? (role) Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isInactive
params.description: Mark the person as inactive. The person will be greyed out and no longer suggested. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isInsurance
params.description: Is the person an insurance company? (role) Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isVendor
params.description: Is the person a vendor? (role) Possible values: true, false.

params.name: language
params.description: The main language of the person. May be used for documents. Possible values: DE, EN, FR, IT.

params.name: locationId
params.description: The ID of the location (workplace) of the employee. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: notes
params.description: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: nr
params.description: The person number (e.g. customer no.).

params.name: position
params.description: The position (job title) of the person within the company.

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.description: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the person number (see nr ). If this is empty, the sequence number will not update when nr is set. See Sequence number .

params.name: servicePeriods
params.description: A list of service periods (entry and exit of the employee). isEmployee must be set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: dateEntry
fields.description: The entry date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: dateExit
fields.description: The exit date. Leave empty if this is the current period. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Some optional notes.

params.name: ssn
params.description: Social security number of the employee. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: superiorId
params.description: The superior of this person (for organizational chart).

params.name: titleId
params.description: The person's title (e.g. 'Mr.', 'Mrs.', 'Dr.'). See Person title .

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user linked to this person. This is a user that can login to CashCtrl. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: vatUid
params.description: The UID (VAT no.) of the company.

params.name: altName
params.description: An alternative name for this person (for organizational chart). This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: attachments
params.description: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: fileId
fields.description: ID of the file to attach. See File .

params.name: bankAccounts
params.description: A list of bank accounts (IBAN, BIC). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: iban
fields.description: The IBAN (International Bank Account Number).

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of bank account, i.e. what is the bank account used for? Possible values: DEFAULT, ORDER, SALARY, HISTORICAL, OTHER.

fields.name: bic
fields.description: The BIC (Business Identifier Code) of your bank.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Some optional notes.

params.name: bankData
params.description: Unstructured bank information, if IBAN/BIC not available. Otherwise use bankAccounts .

params.name: categoryId
params.description: The ID of the category. See Person category .

params.name: certificateTemplateId
params.description: The ID of the salary certificate template. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: certificateValues
params.description: Values to print directly on the employee's salary certificate. isEmployee must be true, otherwise this is ignored. This overrides any values set on the salary certificate template . This is a map of code -> value, for example: {"F": true, "2.3a": "Bonus"}

params.name: children
params.description: A list of children. isEmployee or isFamily must be set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the child (first and last name).

fields.name: dateBenefitBegin
fields.description: Child benefit start date (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: dateBenefitEnd
fields.description: Child benefit end date (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: dateBirth
fields.description: The child's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: dateInEducation
fields.description: Date since child is in education (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Some optional notes.

params.name: color
params.description: The color to use for this person in the organizational chart. Leave empty for white. Possible values: BLUE, GREEN, RED, YELLOW, ORANGE, BLACK, GRAY, BROWN, VIOLET, PINK.

params.name: contacts
params.description: A list of contact information (e-mail, phone, url, etc.). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: address
fields.description: The actual contact information (e-mail address, phone number, etc.).

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of contact information. Possible values: EMAIL_INVOICE, EMAIL_WORK, EMAIL_PRIVATE, PHONE_RECEPTION, PHONE_WORK, PHONE_PRIVATE, MOBILE_WORK, MOBILE_PRIVATE, FAX, WEBSITE, MESSENGER, OTHER.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Some optional short notes.

params.name: custom
params.description: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values> . Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: dateBirth
params.description: The person's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.name: department
params.description: The department of the person within the company.

params.name: discountPercentage
params.description: Discount percentage for this person, which may be used for orders. This can also be set on the category for all people in that category.

params.name: industry
params.description: The industry of the company or the trade/vocation of the person.

params.name: insuranceContracts
params.description: A list of insurance contracts, if isInsurance is set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: typeId
fields.description: ID of the insurance type (e.g. AHV, BVG, etc.).

fields.name: contractNr
fields.description: Number of the contract with the insurance company.

fields.name: subNr
fields.description: Optional sub-contract number, if sub-contracts exist.

params.name: insuranceMemberNr
params.description: Member number (for insurance). isInsurance must be set.

params.name: insuranceNr
params.description: Insurance number. isInsurance must be set.

params.name: isAutoFillResponsiblePerson
params.description: Whether to autofill the responsible person field in order documents with this person if userId is set. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isCustomer
params.description: Is the person a customer? (role) Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isEmployee
params.description: Is the person an employee? (role) Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isFamily
params.description: Is the person a family? (role) Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isInactive
params.description: Mark the person as inactive. The person will be greyed out and no longer suggested. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isInsurance
params.description: Is the person an insurance company? (role) Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isVendor
params.description: Is the person a vendor? (role) Possible values: true, false.

params.name: language
params.description: The main language of the person. May be used for documents. Possible values: DE, EN, FR, IT.

params.name: locationId
params.description: The ID of the location (workplace) of the employee. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: notes
params.description: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: nr
params.description: The person number (e.g. customer no.).

params.name: position
params.description: The position (job title) of the person within the company.

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.description: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the person number (see nr ). If this is empty, the sequence number will not update when nr is set. See Sequence number .

params.name: servicePeriods
params.description: A list of service periods (entry and exit of the employee). isEmployee must be set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: dateEntry
fields.description: The entry date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: dateExit
fields.description: The exit date. Leave empty if this is the current period. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Some optional notes.

params.name: ssn
params.description: Social security number of the employee. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: superiorId
params.description: The superior of this person (for organizational chart).

params.name: titleId
params.description: The person's title (e.g. 'Mr.', 'Mrs.', 'Dr.'). See Person title .

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user linked to this person. This is a user that can login to CashCtrl. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: vatUid
params.description: The UID (VAT no.) of the company.

params.description: The date of the salary statement. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.description: The date of payment. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.name: personId
params.description: The ID of the person (employee).

params.name: statusId
params.description: The ID of the current status.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The ID of the template.

params.name: attachments
params.description: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

fields.name: fileId
fields.description: ID of the file to attach. See File .

params.name: currencyId
params.description: The ID of the currency. Leave empty to use the default currency.

params.name: currencyRate
params.description: The exchange rate from foreign currency to main currency. Only required if the currency is not supported or if you want to use a different rate than suggested.

params.name: custom
params.description: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values> . Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: daysBefore
params.description: The next salary statement will be created X days before the start date. Leave empty or set to 0 to have the next salary statement created on the start date itself. See recurrence parameter.

params.name: endDate
params.description: The end date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). Salary statements repeat automatically up until this date, when the recurrence will stop. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

params.name: insurances
params.description: List of insurances. Whether an insurance is mandatory or not depends on the used salary types (see types ). Each salary type defines the type of insurance required.

fields.name: contractId
fields.description: The ID of the insurance contract. Insurance providers are entered as persons, and each insurance provider can have multiple insurance contracts. A contract consists of an insurance type (e.g. AHV/IV/EO/ALV, BVG, UVG, etc.) and a contract number and, if applicable, a sub number. See Person .

fields.name: codeId
fields.description: The ID of the insurance code (e.g. A1, A2, B1, etc.), if applicable. Each insurance type can have multiple codes. See Insurance type .

params.name: message
params.description: A message for the payment recipient (included in the pain xml file).

params.name: notes
params.description: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: notifyEmail
params.description: The e-mail address to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyPersonId
params.description: The ID of the person to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyType
params.description: Whether to send a notification e-mail when salary statements have been created or not. Leave empty to not send any notification. Possible values: NONE, USER, PERSON, RESPONSIBLE_PERSON, EMAIL.

params.name: notifyUserId
params.description: The ID of the user to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter. Note: User must be in this organization.

params.name: nr
params.description: The salary statement number (e.g. 'LA-202401201'). Leave empty to generate the number with sequenceNumberId . This becomes mandatory if a sequence number is set neither here nor in the template.

params.name: recalculate
params.description: If id is set, values are not recalculated by default. Set this to true to have them recalculated. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: The interval of how often the salary statement should be automatically repeated. Leave empty to not repeat the salary statement. See also startDate and endDate . Possible values: MONTHLY, WEEKLY, DAILY, YEARLY, SEMESTRAL, QUARTERLY, BI_MONTHLY, BI_WEEKLY.

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.description: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the salary statement number (see nr ). If empty, the sequence number of the template is used (if set). See Sequence number .

endpoints.description: Creates a new sequence number. Note that you cannot assign the sequence number to a type (e.g. Journal) here, this is done in the Settings or in the corresponding category (e.g. Order category ). Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: name
params.description: A name to describe and identify the sequence number. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: pattern
params.description: The sequence number pattern, which consists of variables and arbitrary text from which a sequence number will be generated. Possible variables: $y = Current year. $m = Current month. $d = Current day. $ny = Sequence number, resets annually (on Jan 1st). $nm = Sequence number, resets monthly. $nd = Sequence number, resets daily. $nn = Sequence number, never resets. Example pattern: RE-$y$m$d$nd which may generate 'RE-2007151' (on July 15, 2020).

params.name: currentDailyNumber
params.description: The current value of the daily number (variable $nd). Defaults to 1.

params.name: currentInfiniteNumber
params.description: The current value of the infinite number (variable $nn). Defaults to 1.

params.name: currentMonthlyNumber
params.description: The current value of the monthly number (variable $nm). Defaults to 1.

params.name: currentYearlyNumber
params.description: The current value of the yearly number (variable $ny). Defaults to 1.

params.name: dailyNumberDigits
params.description: The number of digits for the daily number (variable $nd). If the number of digits are lower than this, the number will be prepended by zeroes (e.g. 0001 if 4 digits). Defaults to 1.

params.name: dayDigits
params.description: The number of digits for the current day (variable $d). Defaults to 2.

params.name: infiniteNumberDigits
params.description: The number of digits for the infinite number (variable $nn). If the number of digits are lower than this, the number will be prepended by zeroes (e.g. 0001 if 4 digits). Defaults to 1.

params.name: isSkipExisting
params.description: Automatically skip existing sequence numbers? Example: If the next number is 500, but 500 already exists, it will increment the sequence number until a free one is found (max. 100 tries). Possible values: true, false.

params.name: monthDigits
params.description: The number of digits for the current month (variable $m). Defaults to 2.

params.name: monthlyNumberDigits
params.description: The number of digits for the monthly number (variable $nm). If the number of digits are lower than this, the number will be prepended by zeroes (e.g. 0001 if 4 digits). Defaults to 1.

params.name: yearDigits
params.description: The number of digits for the current year (variable $y). Defaults to 4.

params.name: yearlyNumberDigits
params.description: The number of digits for the yearly number (variable $ny). If the number of digits are lower than this, the number will be prepended by zeroes (e.g. 0001 if 4 digits). Defaults to 1.

endpoints.description: Deletes one or multiple sequence numbers. Only unused sequence numbers can be deleted. Returns either a success or error message.

params.description: An optional date, which will influence the next sequence number to be generated. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

endpoints.description: Creates a new tax code. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: code
params.description: A short code to identify the tax code.

params.name: components
params.description: The components of the tax code, up to two possible.

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: ID of the account where the tax amounts are being collected. See Account .

fields.name: applyRule
fields.description: The application rule, on which account (debit or credit side) the tax is applied. Possible values: CREDIT, DEBIT, REVENUE, EXPENSE, LEGACY_REV, LEGACY_EXP.

fields.name: calcType
fields.description: The calculation basis, how the tax is calculated (either based on the net amount or gross amount). Possible values: NET, GROSS.

fields.name: code
fields.description: One or multiple codes, comma-separated, corresponding to the code on the tax return form from the ESTV. Example: 200,303

params.name: rates
params.description: Tax rates that are valid from a given date. Add a new tax rate here if the official tax rate changes. Exactly one tax rate must exist without a valid from date.

fields.name: percentage
fields.description: The tax rate percentage (e.g. 8.1).

fields.name: dateValid
fields.description: The date from which the tax rate will be used. One of the tax rates must have no dateValid set, that is the fallback tax rate. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15 .

fields.name: percentageFlat
fields.description: The net/flat tax rate percentage (e.g. 5.9), if net or flat tax rate method is used, otherwise leave empty.

params.name: description
params.description: A description for the tax code. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: documentName
params.description: The name for the tax code displayed on documents (seen by customers). If isDisplayTaxRate is set, this name doesn't have to include the tax rate percentage, it will be automatically appended. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: isDisplayTaxRate
params.description: Whether to automatically append the current tax rate to the document name (see documentName ) or not. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isInactive
params.description: Mark the tax code as inactive. This means that the tax code is greyed out and no longer suggested. Tax codes already in use cannot be deleted, but you can always set them as inactive. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

endpoints.description: Deletes one or multiple tax codes. Note that you cannot delete tax codes that are being used. Instead use Update tax code to deactivate the tax code. Returns either a success or error message.

To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: isDisplayTaxRate
params.description: Whether to automatically append the current tax rate to the document name (see documentName ) or not. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isInactive
params.description: Mark the tax code as inactive. This means that the tax code is greyed out and no longer suggested. Tax codes already in use cannot be deleted, but you can always set them as inactive. Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isDefault
params.description: Sets the text template as the default text template. Note that text templates defined in order categories are preferred over the default text template, see Order category . Defaults to false. Possible values: true, false.
